description: Turns an ordinary solid of constant wall thickness (an L or U profile extruded) into the part's sheet metal: fixed_face stays where it is, and each sharp inner edge named becomes a bend of bend_radius_mm (inner radius). The allowance becomes the part's default (SOLIDWORKS' own when absent). Refused on a part that is already sheet metal: a part has one sheet-metal body. Lengths in mm. Checked before SOLIDWORKS is called: the fixed face is planar and borders a bend edge; each bend edge is straight, between two planar faces, and an inner (concave) corner. Checked after: the part is sheet metal with one sheet body, Sheet-Metal and Flat-Pattern exist, the thickness reads back and measures thickness_mm; one bend per edge named at the radius asked; the part's box is unchanged within the thickness. Otherwise everything it made is deleted and the part is as it was (rolled back). Busy with user_editing while the user is editing a sketch or has a command open. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The part: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

fixed_face.description: The face that stays put, by reference: a planar inner face of the solid, one that borders a bend edge (model.find gives it). An outer face is refused.

bend_edges.description: The sharp inner edges that become bends, by reference (model.find gives them).

thickness_mm.description: The sheet's thickness, mm, more than 0: the solid's wall thickness.

bend_radius_mm.description: The bends' inner radius, mm, more than 0; it becomes the part's default.

k_factor.description: The K-factor: where the neutral layer sits across the thickness, more than 0 and at most 1 (0.5 is the middle). The bend develops to angle × (inner radius + K × thickness).

allowance_mm.description: The bend allowance itself, mm, more than 0: the length the bend develops to, whatever its angle.

deduction_mm.description: The bend deduction, mm, 0 or more: what the bend takes off the sum of the two flanges' outer lengths to the virtual sharp.

allowance.description: The part's default bend allowance: exactly one of k_factor, allowance_mm or deduction_mm. SOLIDWORKS' own default when absent.

reverse_thickness.description: Thicken to the other side of the fixed face (inward, so the part shrinks by the thickness). Default false.

keep_body.description: Keep the original solid as a body beside the sheet. Default false.
